summary.content:
Today's selection covers 73 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 52 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Google Releases Three New Gemini A.I. Models
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Critical Palo Alto VPN bug now exploited by Qilin ransomware gang
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 51 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: Google Releases Three New Gemini A.I. Models
